content.title:
Exam day is done.
*What comes next?*
content.subtitle: IIM B UGAT is today. Three ways to help your child plan the next step.

qa.q: Should we discuss the paper tonight?
qa.a: Let them rest first. A short chat tomorrow about what went well and what felt hard helps more than a post-mortem tonight.

qa.q: What is the next big exam?
qa.a: For most IPM aspirants it is IPMAT Indore 2027, which IIM Indore has announced for Saturday, 24 April 2027.
Help them settle into a steady weekly routine: regular practice, one mock a week and enough sleep.
qa.note: Always check the official websites for dates and eligibility.
